Companion Animal Travel Desk Notice

Travelers need to know that our desk is still checking companion travel details with a steady, practical hand. We are keeping guidance simple, kind, and clear so pets and people can move through the day without extra hassle.

If you are planning a trip with a pet, send along the basics early and keep your care notes easy to read. We look at each case step by step, with attention to species, temperament, and comfort. That helps us match the right travel setup and avoid last-minute scrambles. If a situation needs more review, we handle it calmly and pass it along in order.

Aurelia Skyways is committed to dependable companion travel, and the Companion Animal Travel Desk is here to keep that promise on track. Bring your questions to the desk before you head out, and we will help sort the details. Companion Animal Travel Desk
